Terms and information limits

Independent community guidance—not government or professional advice.

Use Franklin Navigator as a starting point, confirm changing details at the original source and use appropriate professionals or emergency services when needed.

Built for Franklin

Not a national directory with a Franklin label. Profiles, local tools, participation paths and membership are organized around the Franklin community itself.

  • Free factual profile review and corrections
  • Clear local participation tools
  • Simple Community Membership choices

Independent community platform

Franklin Navigator is built specifically for Franklin, Tennessee. It is not a government agency and does not claim nonprofit status. A link, listing, profile or Community Membership does not establish affiliation or endorsement.

Profiles and corrections

Public-source profiles, member-provided content and authority verification are separate. Factual corrections remain free. Location, credentials, services, availability and other changing information must be verified directly.

Community Membership

When live enrollment opens, monthly and annual memberships renew until canceled. The three-year option is a one-time prepaid 36-month term and does not automatically renew. The exact amount, founding terms, renewal behavior and cancellation access must be shown before payment.

Founding terms

Eligible monthly memberships receive $3.50/month for the first 12 months before the regular $5/month price. Eligible annual memberships receive $35 for the first year before the regular $50/year price. The $120 three-year founding offer is separate, non-stackable and followed only by a fresh renewal choice after the 36-month term.

Refund and payment support

General checkout remains closed. Before any three-year payment is accepted, Franklin Navigator must publish the final owner-approved refund terms. Payment, entitlement, cancellation and refund records must reconcile through the verified member system.

No purchased rank or guaranteed result

Membership does not buy factual accuracy, credentials, suitability, directory rank, endorsement, leads, customers, sales, revenue, ROI or any guaranteed outcome.

Growth Desk and outreach

Tools may help prepare appropriate business-audience plans and communications. Public contactability is not consent. No raw bulk contact export, bought resident list, robocall, unsolicited automated SMS or identity-based language inference is authorized.

Professional, emergency and third-party matters

Franklin Navigator is not legal, medical, financial or emergency advice. Call 911 for active emergencies. External websites control their content, availability, privacy and terms.

Respectful use

Do not misuse profiles or tools for harassment, deception, unlawful outreach, unauthorized scraping, impersonation or false claims of affiliation.
